defaultValue.innerText: An umbrella company employs you on a single ongoing contract while you work on different assignments, handling your payroll, tax and National Insurance so you don't have to run your own limited company. You get the flexibility of contracting with the continuity and compliance of being an employee.

props.name: FAQ 2 Question
props.defaultValue: How much will I take home?

defaultValue.innerText: Your take-home pay depends on your day or hourly rate, the assignment length and current tax thresholds. Use our net pay calculator for an estimate, or speak to the team for a tailored breakdown.
We process payments as soon as funds clear from your agency or client, usually the same day, so you're paid promptly after each timesheet is approved.

props.name: FAQ 4 Question
props.defaultValue: Is my pay protected against IR35 and compliance changes?

defaultValue.innerText: Yes. We operate fully compliant payroll that's kept up to date with HMRC legislation, so you're covered whatever changes come into effect.

props.name: FAQ 5 Question
props.defaultValue: How do I get started with Giant?

defaultValue.innerText: Getting set up takes minutes: register online, upload your ID, and we'll handle onboarding with your agency so you're ready to work from day one.

props.name: FAQ 6 Question
props.defaultValue: Can I work through Giant across multiple agencies at once?

defaultValue.innerText: Yes — one continuous employment with Giant can cover assignments from different agencies at the same time, so your pay, holiday and pension stay consolidated under a single contract.

props.name: FAQ 7 Question
props.defaultValue: What happens to my holiday pay?

defaultValue.innerText: Holiday pay accrues on every assignment and is paid out either rolled up into each payslip or reserved and paid when you take leave, depending on the option you choose when you register.

props.name: FAQ 8 Question
props.defaultValue: Who do I contact if something looks wrong with my payslip?

defaultValue.innerText: Your dedicated Giant contact can walk through any payslip line by line — reach out through the portal or your usual contact and we'll get it sorted the same day.

name: Tag Size
description: Padding-only sizing wrapper for Typography Tag. Small (default) = 0.5rem vertical / 0.75rem horizontal padding, matching the original tag proportions. Medium = 0.75rem vertical / 1rem horizontal. Decouples size from the tag's color/border Style variant so any look (Base/Solid/Outline/Light) can be either size.

name: Tag Colour
description: Colour axis for Typography Tag (mirrors Badge Core). The variant picks a fill/contrast palette from the Tag Colour variable collection: Inherit (default — follows the section's accent), Dark (theme text on theme background, flips in dark sections), Light, or a business-unit colour. Typography Tag's own variant (Solid/Outline/Text Only) decides which of fill/contrast paints the background, border and text.

name: Products and Services List
description: Collection List of Card Product tiles from the Products and Services collection, with no layout of its own (all wrappers are display: contents). Drop it inside a Grid component's Content slot and the Grid's column props control the layout. Filter the Collection List to the page's audience (Audiences contains …). Each card takes name, Best for bullets, business-area tag and accent from the item.

name: Filter Button
description: A filter pill for the GIANT Filters engine (Global Styles). The root is a real <button> carrying data-filter="button", so the engine toggles .is-active and aria-pressed on it directly. Text = visible label. Value = what it filters on (leave empty to match the label; "*" = show all). Rest state: outlined in the theme text colour, heading font; pressed: primary button tokens. Used in a wrapping flex row (u-flex-horizontal-wrap u-gap-2).

props.name: Text
props.tooltip: Visible label of the pill.

props.name: Value
props.tooltip: What this pill filters on (must equal the item's category text). Leave empty to use the label. "*" = show all.

name: Filter Search
description: Search field for the GIANT Filters engine (Global Styles): a <label> (data-trigger="focus") holding a screen-reader label, the Figma magnifier icon and a native <input type="search" data-filter="search"> on form_field + is-search (background-2 fill, main radius, 24px icon inset). No <form> needed. Label = accessible name; Placeholder = hint text. Width follows the input's size attribute (30 characters) and shrinks to fit.

props.name: Label

props.name: Placeholder

name: Filter Sort
description: Unboxed "Sort by" control for the GIANT Filters engine: a <label> holding a screen-reader label, a native <select data-filter="sort"> styled as plain 16px text, and the Figma 24px chevron. The first option is the "Sort by" placeholder (value empty = the list's own order); drop Form Select Option instances into the Options slot with values like name:asc, name:desc, category:asc.
